body: Give your team a report they can read, discuss, and work on together. In this walkthrough, turn the fictional Acme sales analysis into a Page in Space, with the highlights, quarterly comparisons, and charts in one place. See how to choose who can access the report, copy a link for your meeting, edit a heading directly, ask ChatGPT questions about the report, and leave comments beside the findings you want to discuss. Create and edit Pages: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/space/pages Share a Page or Space: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/space/collaboration#share-a-page-or-space Part 5 of the Data Agent series.
